主要内容: On January 21, 2014, SAP AG, a German-based company, issued a press release announcing its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2013. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 and provides details on non-IFRS financial measures, which are not prepared in accordance with IFRS. These measures should be considered in addition to, and not as substitutes for, traditional financial performance metrics. The document also includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to various risks and uncertainties. Readers are advised not to place undue reliance on these statements, as they are only valid as of their respective dates. This document is a Form 6-K filing by SAP AG, dated January 24, 2014. It includes a press release dated January 21, 2014, and signatures from Christoph Huetten and Sonja Simon, who are authorized representatives of the company. The filing is related to the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and includes the exhibit index for the press release. The document is part of the company's official reporting process.
